result.question: What happens to Abimelech at Thebez tower?

readings.answer: A woman crushes his skull with an upper millstone.
readings.support: a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull

readings.answer: His armor-bearer runs him through and he dies.
readings.support: Abimelech’s armor-bearer ran his sword through him, and he died

readings.answer: He approaches the tower entrance to set it on fire.
readings.support: he approached its entrance to set it on fire
